input.title: Add alt text to the location map on the contact page
input.rationale: The image is a street map showing where the studio is. That location information is useful, so the image needs alt text and an empty alt would hide it. In the map, a red marker labelled "Studio" sits on the north–south street between Kiln Lane and Mill Street, and a "Station" box is further south on the same street. The alt text gives that location in a short phrase. The north–south street has no name on the map, so the alt text doesn't name it. The reviewer should check that this matches the real address, and could add the address as visible text on the page.

ops.name: alt
ops.value: Map: the studio is between Kiln Lane and Mill Street, on the same street as the station, north of it
